subject: Re: Trial kickoff — environment choice, success criteria & owners
body:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya.singh@brightledger.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Trial kickoff — environment choice, success criteria & owners

Hi Maya —

Thanks again for the call today. Below is a concise recap and proposed plan so we can kick off the trial next week. I added owners and a proposed timeline so nothing falls through the cracks.

Summary of what we heard on the call
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference for transaction enrichment and fraud-scoring microservices (latency + cost + quality).
- Data: low-volume PII (hashed IDs), may require encryption-at-rest and audit logs for production.
- Success criteria you called out: 95th p50/p95 latency target, token cost per inference budget, and semantic parity with your baseline model.

Recommended trial approach (phased)
1) Phase A — Hosted API (fast start, 3 days)
   - Purpose: functional validation and prompting/eval capture; minimal setup overhead.
   - Deliverables: sample prompts, evaluation harness, and initial latency/cost numbers.
   - Owner: Jonas (sales) + Marissa (SE) for test prompts.
2) Phase B — Dedicated sandbox (1 week provisioning + 1 week test)
   - Purpose: throughput testing, sustained latency SLOs, perf tuning (batching/kv cache).
   - Deliverables: dedicated GPU pool, config profile, load test report.
   - Owner: Karthik (perf lead) + Marissa.
3) Phase C — VPC trial (optional, 2–3 weeks)
   - Purpose: security/compliance checks (KMS, private networking, audit logs) prior to production.
   - Prereqs: network ranges, firewall rules, KMS key access.
   - Owner: BrightLedger infra + Marissa for onboarding.

Proposed success criteria (measurable)
- Functional: model outputs meet 85% acceptance rate on your spot-check prompts (you provide 50 gold examples).
- Latency: end-to-end 95th <= 300 ms for the enrichment path under production-like request size during Phase B.
- Throughput: sustain 1,000 req/min in dedicated sandbox while keeping cost below $X/token (we'll provide estimate).
- Security: audit logs and encrypted-at-rest verified in VPC trial (if pursued).

Attachments I attached: trial_scope.xlsx (detailed test cases) and redwood_trial_config_v1.json (example config).

Next steps + timeline
- Can we confirm kickoff on Tue, Feb 24 for a 30-min alignment and access handoff?
- Maya: please confirm which environment you want to start with (we recommend Hosted -> Dedicated).
- Maya: share infra contact for VPC prep if you want to pursue Phase C.

Thanks — I’ll also loop Marissa and Karthik for environment/setup questions.

--
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0110

-----
From: Maya Singh <maya.singh@brightledger.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@brightledger.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Feb 2026 09:05:12 -0500
Subject: Re: Trial kickoff — environment choice, success criteria & owners

Thanks Jonas — this looks good and aligned with what we discussed. A couple of clarifications/questions before kickoff: 

1) Data residency & PII: our legal team requires audit logs and proof of encryption-at-rest for any environment that touches customer PII. We can start with hashed IDs in Hosted, but any sustained trial against real data will need at least dedicated sandbox with KMS.
2) Latency SLO: we can confirm the 95th <= 300 ms target, but can you also provide a 50th/90th target and sample SLA for the Dedicated tier?
3) Cost: please give a rough cost ballpark for hitting 1,000 req/min in Dedicated so we can budget.

Assuming answers above, we prefer to start Phase A (Hosted) for functional validation and then gate Dedicated provisioning on smoke results.

Ethan (cc) is our infra lead who will coordinate network/KMS if we move to VPC.

Maya
Maya Singh
Head of Product | BrightLedger
maya.singh@brightledger.com

-----
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya.singh@brightledger.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Feb 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Trial kickoff — environment choice, success criteria & owners

Appreciate the quick reply — answers inline and next actions: 

1) Data residency & PII: agreed — Hosted is fine for hashed/obfuscated test data. For any customer data or PII we will require Dedicated or VPC with KMS. We will treat Phase A as strictly non-production test data.
2) Latency SLOs: we will target p50=~60ms, p90=~160ms, p95<=300ms as a practical baseline for typical enrichment requests. We will surface a Dedicated SLA proposal in the provisioning doc prior to Phase B.
3) Cost: rough estimate for Dedicated (provisioned pool sized for 1k req/min) is in the attachment; we'll provide a more detailed cost model after we confirm expected token sizes and sequence lengths.

Kickoff: Tue Feb 24 at 10:00 AM PT works on our side for a 30-min alignment + secrets/access handoff.

Action owners:
- Jonas: run Phase A onboarding + initial eval harness (due Fri Feb 27).
- Marissa: will own env provisioning and checklist for Dedicated/VPC (see attached checklist).
- Karthik: will own throughput tuning & load-run plans for Phase B.
- BrightLedger: provide 50 gold prompts, infra contact (Ethan), and a sample request/response payload.

If that looks good I’ll send a calendar invite and include the runbook checklist.

Thanks,
Jonas

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya.singh@brightledger.com>, Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@brightledger.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Feb 2026 08:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Trial kickoff — environment choice, success criteria & owners

Hi all — adding a practical checklist per environment so BrightLedger knows what we’ll need and the time-to-ready.

Hosted (Phase A) — Time to ready: same day
- What we need from BrightLedger: sample payloads, 50 gold prompts, target token size estimate.
- Redwood deliverables: Hosted API key, example client calls, shared eval harness (automated).
- Notes: no KMS required; audit log sampling available via console.

Dedicated sandbox (Phase B) — Time to ready: ~5–7 business days
- What we need from BrightLedger: expected peak RPM, concurrency, preferred region (us-west-2), billing contact.
- Redwood deliverables: reserved GPU pool, private project namespace, perf test harness, cost estimate.
- Config artifacts: redwood_trial_config_v1.json (attached) — contains sample batch sizes, kv cache policy, and quantization profile recommendations.
- Performance gating: sustain 1,000 req/min for 30 minutes with p95 <= 300 ms while keeping estimated cost under agreed cap.

VPC trial (Phase C) — Time to ready: ~10–15 business days (depends on customer IT)
- Customer pre-reqs: static IP ranges, VPC peering/VPN details, KMS key ARN, firewall rules, SAML metadata for SSO (optional).
- Redwood deliverables: private control plane connection, deployment scripts, audit-log export, compliance checklist.

Costs/Estimates
- Phase A: minimal, covered under trial credits for first 100k tokens.
- Phase B: cost depends on sustained throughput — rough estimate attached; we will refine after payloads are shared.

Risks & mitigation
- If Dedicated provisioning is delayed, we will extend Phase A to run longer smoke tests and capture evaluation data.
- If VPC network setup is slow, we can run acceptance tests using an encrypted S3 drop for logs and KMS-wrapped artifacts.

I’ll be available on Tue for the kickoff; Karthik and I can own the environment setup and run the first load tests once we have test data and the green light.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachment stubs: trial_scope.xlsx (see 'Test cases' tab), redwood_trial_config_v1.json (sample config with batch/kv settings).
